Parity details

The comparisons behind the overview's parity scores.

Parity (measured after determinism)

Parity compares a backend's log with ptrace's after both pass the repeatability check. The compared backends are kvm, liteinst, sabre, dbt, in-guest-trap; their test inputs must match. A full log match scores 1. Otherwise, the score is the matching start of the logs divided by the length of the longer log. Parity has its own denominator: tests selected for ptrace verification, on each candidate backend. Tests without a usable ptrace log, cases with incompatible inputs, and cases omitted from a sampled run are excluded. Disabled, missing or failed candidate results score 0. These scores come from the saved parity summary, checked against its run records. Download the summary and recorded comparisons.
